user.title: Set up Planzer
user.description: Planzer tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `planzer.track_parcel` service.

data_description.add: Enter a Planzer shipment number (e.g. 12345678) or your IKEA Switzerland order number (e.g. 98765.0012345678) — the shipment number is derived for you.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

data_description.refresh_interval: How often the integration checks Planzer for parcel updates. A slower interval is gentler on Planzer's API; the default of 30 minutes is plenty for most parcels.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Planzer shipment number. Enter the bare number (e.g. 12345678) or a full IKEA order number.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Planzer shipment number.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Planzer shipment number, or the IKEA Switzerland order number it came from.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Planzer shipment number.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Planzer shipment number to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
